description: Search the live NOSTOS catalog of retro games, consoles, and vintage apparel. Free-text query plus platform, department, region, condition, and price filters. Returns online-buyable items by default. Every item is unique and individually graded.

includeSold.description: Include sold and in-store-only items. Default false (online-buyable only).

platform.description: Filter by platform (case-insensitive substring), e.g. 'Saturn', 'N64', 'Game Boy'.

query.description: Free-text match across name, description, genre, and platform. All words must match.

region.description: Filter by exact region code, e.g. 'JP', 'US', 'PAL'.

name: search_inventory
title: Search the catalog
